title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 10: Jeffry McWild
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．１０ 「ジェフリー・マクワイルト」
overview:
Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series is a series of eleven Sega Saturn discs released in Japan between October 1995 and March 1996, each containing images of one Virtua Fighter character.

This disc features Jeffry McWild (born February 20, 1957). He is a fisherman who mastered Pankration on his own. Jeffry will stop at nothing to defeat his rival of many years, the dreaded Satan Shark. He is of Australian Aboriginal descent.
